## Requirement

<a id="MarkOnBody"></a>

### A landmark on the body

`MarkOnBody` · `src/marks.ts:65` · status: **held**

What a landmark draws on a body: each line from spot to spot (dashed in dashes and gaps), a plumb line dashed down to the floor, a dot, an arrow and its head, an angle as an arc between the two directions with its two rays, soft, and its measure rounded, set beyond the arc on the line that halves it; a soft thin line from its spot to its words.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
(mark: Mark, body: Body, sides: Sides): MarkDrawing => {
    const look = MarkLook.value
    const at = (s: Parameters<typeof SpotOn>[1]) => SpotOn(body, s, sides)
    const drawing: MarkDrawing = { segments: [], dots: [], heads: [], angles: [], label: [0, 0, 0] }
    const line = (a: Vec, b: Vec, width = look.line, soft = false) => drawing.segments.push({ from: a, to: b, width, soft })
    const dashed = (a: Vec, b: Vec) => {
      const d = sub(b, a)
      const l = len(d)
      for (let s = 0; s < l; s += look.dash + look.gap) line(add(a, mul(d, s / l)), add(a, mul(d, Math.min(s + look.dash, l) / l)))
    }
    for (const shape of mark.shapes ?? []) {
      if ("line" in shape) shape.line.slice(1).forEach((s, i) => (shape.dashed ? dashed : line)(at(shape.line[i]), at(s)))
      else if ("plumb" in shape) {
        const p = at(shape.plumb)
        dashed(p, [p[0], 0.01, p[2]])
      } else if ("dot" in shape) drawing.dots.push({ at: at(shape.dot), radius: look.dot })
      else if ("arrow" in shape) {
        const [a, b] = [at(shape.arrow[0]), at(shape.arrow[1])]
        line(a, b, look.shaft)
        drawing.heads.push({ at: b, toward: unit(sub(b, a)) })
      } else {
        const { at: j0, from, to, radius } = shape.angle
        const j = at(j0)
        const u = unit(sub(at(from), j))
        const w = unit(sub(at(to), j))
        const theta = (AngleBetween(j, at(from), at(to)) * Math.PI) / 180
        const across = sub(w, mul(u, dot(u, w)))
        const v: Vec = len(across) < 1e-5 ? [0, 0, 1] : unit(across)
        const arc = Array.from({ length: look.arc + 1 }, (_, k) => add(j, add(mul(u, Math.cos((theta * k) / look.arc) * radius), mul(v, Math.sin((theta * k) / look.arc) * radius))))
        arc.slice(1).forEach((q, k) => line(arc[k], q))
        line(j, add(j, mul(u, radius * look.ray)), look.thin, true)
        line(j, add(j, mul(w, radius * look.ray)), look.thin, true)
        const degrees = Math.round(AngleBetween(j, at(from), at(to)) / look.roundTo) * look.roundTo
        drawing.angles.push({ at: add(j, mul(unit(add(u, w)), radius + look.beyond)), degrees })
      }
    }
    const anchor = at(mark.at)
    drawing.label = add(anchor, mark.label)
    line(anchor, drawing.label, look.thin, true)
    return drawing
  }
```

</details>

## Decisions

<a id="MarkLook"></a>

### How landmarks are drawn

`MarkLook` · `src/marks.ts:25`

The lengths of a landmark's drawing, in metres: a dash and the gap after it, the width of a line, of a thin line and of an arrow's shaft, the radius of a dot; an angle's arc in 24 pieces, its two rays a quarter longer than its radius, its measure 9 cm beyond the arc and rounded to 5°; the floor a centimetre down.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| dash | 0.04 |
| gap | 0.03 |
| line | 0.01 |
| thin | 0 |
| shaft | 0.01 |
| dot | 0.02 |
| arc | 24 |
| ray | 1.25 |
| beyond | 0.09 |
| roundTo | 5 |

- Decided by: ghalaax
- Used by: [A landmark on the body](#MarkOnBody)

<a id="MarksWhen"></a>

### When the landmarks are drawn

`MarksWhen` · `src/marks.ts:35`

Whenever the person wants them, in every practice: while a pose is held, at a pause and at the end, drawn once on the still body; while the body moves, those of the pose it goes to, on the body as it is, following it.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| still | true |
| moving | true |

- Decided by: ghalaax
- Rejected: Only while the body is still, a practice that flows with the breath never stops: there the button showed nothing, and the landmarks appeared only when learning a sequence or holding poses
- Used by: [The moment of a practice](practice.md#MomentOf)
